people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Hazael
people.line: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.

people.name: Joram
people.line: King of N. Israel, son of Ahab

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
translations.bsb: Then Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, and the Arameans wounded Joram.
translations.kjv: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
translations.asv: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians wounded Joram.
